title: The Wizard of Oz
synopsis: Kansas, then not Kansas. A cyclone. A pair of shoes. A road of yellow brick. The lion needs courage. The wizard, you'll find, needs you.

nodes.text: Auntie Em. Uncle Henry. Miss Gulch with a bicycle. Toto in your arms.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Family.
You commit to “Run away.” The story records the instinct as “Spirit” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You meet Professor Marvel. He reads your future kindly.

choices.consequence: “Listen” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Spirit—follows you into whatever comes next.

Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You stay in Kansas. You marry, eventually. Your children grow up listening to a story their teachers don't quite believe. The shoes, you keep in a drawer.
Years later you find a way back. You become, eventually, the steward of Emerald City. The scarecrow and tin man are, by then, regents. The lion is, mostly, a sleepy mayor.
You write the book down. The book becomes a movie. The movie becomes part of every Sunday afternoon for decades. You die quietly. Toto is, by then, a small grand-pup.
